text: do i need to just replace this on the desk or something? look how far the computer hovers over the desk [Image #13]
resolution: The computer (and other mount:'surface' props) floated above the desk. I traced the placement/lift chain headlessly and found NO bug — every path lands a dropped prop on the desk's bounds-top (0.8m), so the float came from stray/stale placement data I couldn't see, not the code. Per the user's pick, implemented the robust fix (req_0771): restSurfaceMountProps() runs at the end of liftBuildingsToTerrain (game/build/placed.ts) — the ONE render-prep chokepoint both the editor displayPieces and the compiled bake flow through — and drops every mount:'surface' prop onto the HIGHEST solid piece-top beneath its anchor (a desk/counter/shelf), else the terrain. A 0.35m upward grace snaps a slightly-buried item up onto its surface; surfaces ABOVE the prop are never grabbed. Because it's a lift-time pass, EXISTING floating placements self-correct on both display and bake — no re-placement needed. Verified: hmsc-int bundles clean; 129 tests pass across 7 suites; a probe placing a computer floating at y=1.6 over a desk rests it at y=0.8 (desk top), and one buried at 0.5 snaps up to 0.8. GIT: change is in placed.ts, which the parallel session's recent commits already swept — this edit is uncommitted on disk (coherent, tested); commit sequencing deferred to the supervisor as with the other footprint work.
